name: Wall of Slaughter: Barricades
summary: Fortified Muramite defensive positions reinforced with siege engines, chokepoints, and Discord‑warped fortifications.
description: The Barricades represent the Muramite Legion’s primary defensive line within the Wall of Slaughter. Massive fortifications, reinforced trenches, and siege engines dominate the terrain. Muramite engineers maintain chokepoints designed to funnel resistance forces into kill zones. Discord corruption has warped several barricades, creating unstable planar hazards and unpredictable terrain shifts. This zone is heavily patrolled, strategically fortified, and represents the Muramite Legion’s strongest defensive posture before the Rift Breach and War Gate.
